2) The CEO / Chief Engineer will be responsible for completing all the remaining works within the prescribed time frame at the above mentioned revised cost.
3) The terms and conditions mentioned while granting the revised technical approval as well as the original administrative approval agreed to the scheme should be strictly adhered to.

4) On completion of the scheme, it should be handed over to the concerned Gram Panchayat. The concerned Gram Panchayat / Zilla Parishad / Maharashtra Jeevan Authority shall be responsible for taking over the scheme within one month from the date of receipt of intimation from the concerned Executive Engineer, Rural Water Supply Department, Zila Parishad that the scheme has actually been completed. Immediately after the actual completion of the scheme, a joint inspection of the scheme should be conducted by the concerned Executive Engineer, Zilla Parishad / Maharashtra Jeevan Authority and the concerned Gram Panchayat officials and if any defects are found in such inspection, they should be rectified before handing over the scheme.

5) The Gram Panchayat / Zilla Parishad / Maharashtra Jeevan Authority concerned shall not receive any assistance from the Government for meeting the annual expenditure towards implementation of the scheme, maintenance, repairs (including special modifications), depreciation in the scheme or renovation of machinery.

6) On completion of the scheme, it will be mandatory for the local body (concerned Gram Panchayat / Zilla Parishad / Maharashtra Jeevan Authority) to implement the scheme. The accounts of the scheme should also be closed.

7) According to a CAG report in 2013, 21 per cent of water supply schemes in the state have been shut down due to poor maintenance / non-payment of electricity of bills due to lack of these maintenance repairs. In order to make the AAS scheme more efficient, it will be the responsibility of the respective Gram Panchayat / Zilla Parishad / Maharashtra Jeevan Authority to increase the water tariff as per requirement.
8) Action should be taken in accordance with the prevailing policy on extortion.
9) It shall be the responsibility of the Zilla Parishad / Maharashtra Jeevan Authority that the present scheme shall not be revised under any circumstances.

10) Since no administrative expenditure is admissible under the Jal Jeevan Mission, it should be excluded if 4% of the administrative expenditure has been taken up in the revised budget of the scheme.
